text: 金十数据11月4日讯，倍轻松公告，公司控股股东、实际控制人马学军收到中国证监会《行政处罚决定书》。此前马学军因涉嫌操纵证券市场被立案调查，2026年6月收到《行政处罚事先告知书》。本次决定书显示，对马学军等7人操纵"倍轻松"行为没收违法所得1011.83万元，并处以3035.48万元罚款，合计4047.31万元，其中马学军承担1184.19万元；对马学军采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 4: Breo announced that controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. Ma Xuejun had previously been investigated for suspected manipulation of the securities market and received a Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty in June 2026. The decision shows that for the manipulation of "Breo" by Ma Xuejun and six others, illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan were confiscated and a fine of 30.3548 million yuan was imposed, totaling 40.4731 million yuan, of which Ma Xuejun bears 11.8419 million yuan. Ma Xuejun was subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading.
